g: (historical) An old Dutch sailing barge with a round bow, leeboards and a gaff-rigged mast.
A pen-like tool used to apply liquid wax in the batik process.

(Sherlock fandom slang) The Johnlock Conspiracy; a theory prevalent in Sherlock fandom before series four, which interpreted the show as having a strong queer subtext, and held that the showrunners intended an eventual romance between Sherlock and John.
(Sherlock fandom slang) A proponent of The Johnlock Conspiracy (TJLC).
(Australia) An object of religious significance among Aboriginal peoples of Central Australia.
